title: Regularity descends along flat maps surjective on spectra
statement: Let $A\to B\to C$ be ring maps of commutative rings. If the composite $A\to C$ is a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], and $B\to C$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and induces a surjective map $\operatorname{Spec}C\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ (every prime ideal of $B$ is the inverse image of a prime ideal of $C$), then $A\to B$ is a regular ring map.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 07NT (lemma-regular-permanence, line 10507); its proof uses Algebra Lemma 039V (lemma-flat-permanence) and Algebra Lemma 07NH (lemma-geometrically-regular-descent)

proof.text: Since B → C is flat and surjective on prime spectra, Mathlib's faithfully-flat criterion [lem-weil-pbc-flat-surjective-spectrum-faithfully-flat] gives Module.FaithfullyFlat B C. Unfold regularity [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] to get flatness of C over A. Apply the already proved source-library algebra special case [lem-weil-pbc-flat-algebra-faithfully-flat-descent], Module.Flat.of_flat_of_faithfullyFlat, to obtain flatness of B over A.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07NT, first sentence; Algebra Lemma Tag 039V

proof.text: Fix a prime p of A. Let f : p.Fiber B →ₐ[κ(p)] p.Fiber C be Algebra.TensorProduct.lTensor κ(p) (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B C); give p.Fiber C the algebra structure induced by f. Mathlib's Algebra.IsPushout.cancelBaseChangeAlg and cancelBaseChange_symm_comp_lTensor give an equivalence p.Fiber C ≃ₐ[p.Fiber B] (p.Fiber B) ⊗[B] C. Tensor cancellation [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-cancel-base-change] thus identifies the fibre map with base change of B → C. Faithful flatness under arbitrary base change [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-base-change] and transport through this linear equivalence give Module.FaithfullyFlat (p.Fiber B) (p.Fiber C). The composite's regularity supplies geometric regularity of p.Fiber C [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. Apply Algebra.isGeometricallyRegular_of_faithfullyFlat [lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-regular-descent] to obtain geometric regularity of p.Fiber B.

source.place: More on Algebra, proof of Lemma Tag 07NT, second and third sentences; Algebra Lemma Tags 00HI and 07NH

proof.text: The fibre $B\otimes_A\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ is Noetherian as required in the definition of a regular ring map: geometric regularity in [def-weil-pbc-g-ring] includes Noetherianity after every finite purely inseparable field extension, and the descent lemma [lem-weil-pbc-geometrically-regular-descent] preserves this regular-ring condition. Thus $A\to B$ is flat with Noetherian geometrically regular fibres, exactly the definition of a regular ring map [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].
